## `inv:Item`

A physical thing that is tracked.

Fields:

| Field | Type | Base | Flags | Default | Mutability | Values and limits | Declared in | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `acquired_on` | base `date` | date |  |  | immutable |  | `inv:Item` | Date the item was acquired. |
| `condition` | enum `inv:Condition` | string |  |  | content | one of `new`, `good`, `worn`, `damaged` | `inv:Item` | Physical condition. |
| `name` | base `string` | string | required |  | content |  | `inv:Item` | Display name of the item. |
| `quantity` | datatype `inv:Quantity` | integer | required | `1` | content | min `0` | `inv:Item` | Number of units. |
| `serial_number` | datatype `inv:SerialNumber` | string | unique |  | immutable | pattern `^[A-Z0-9-]{4,32}$` | `inv:Item` | Serial number, if the item has one. |
| `status` | lifecycle `inv:ItemLifecycle` | string | required |  | lifecycle |  | `inv:Item` | Availability state. |

Lifecycle `status` (`inv:ItemLifecycle`): Availability of an item.

- State `ordered` (initial): Bought but not received.
- State `in_stock`: Received and available.
- State `in_use`: Handed out and in use.
- State `retired` (terminal): Out of service for good.
- `ordered` -> `in_stock`
- `in_stock` -> `in_use`: guard `inv.usable`: Damaged items cannot be used.
- `in_use` -> `in_stock`
- `ordered` -> `retired`: guard `inv.no_active_parts`: An item with active parts cannot be retired.
- `in_stock` -> `retired`: guard `inv.no_active_parts`: An item with active parts cannot be retired.
- `in_use` -> `retired`: guard `inv.no_active_parts`: An item with active parts cannot be retired.

Relations out:

| Relation | To | Cardinality | Inverse | Qualifiers | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inv:in_category` | `inv:Category` | 0..n | `has_item` |  | The item belongs to the category. |
| `inv:located_in` | `inv:Location` | 1..1 | `holds` |  | Where an item is stored. |
| `inv:part_of` | `inv:Item` | 0..1 | `has_part` |  | The item is a component of a larger item. |

Relations in:

| Relation | From | Cardinality in | Inverse | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `inv:part_of` | `inv:Item` | 0..n | `has_part` | The item is a component of a larger item. |

Rules:

|---|---|---|---|
| `inv.serial_single_unit` | error | write | Serialized items have quantity 1. |
